title: Install two RAM sticks (Franka, operational-space control)
text: Install the two RAM sticks in the PC: the stick from the holder farther from the robot in the outermost memory slot, the other in the second slot from the CPU socket.
success: Success: both sticks are pressed fully into their slots, straight and square: the stick from the farther holder in the outermost slot (farthest from the CPU socket), the other in the second slot from the socket, each facing the way it stands in its holder (not reversed).
